title: Progression App
summary: A gamified project tracker for people who start projects and lose track of them. Each project is broken into milestones shown one page at a time; clicking Next fills a progress bar, and finishing a project triggers a celebration screen and a copy-ready resume insert. Plans can be generated by the in-app AI or imported from any external AI chat.

decisions: FastAPI is a pure JSON API; React handles all rendering, chosen partly to build React experience
Frontend and API are served from one origin (Vite proxy in dev) so a plain HTTP-only session cookie works without CORS issues
Data model: User, Project, Milestone, Message
A new version (2.0, 3.0) is a new Project row with parent_project_id, so completed projects stay frozen for interview review
Messages can optionally attach to a milestone so each milestone page has its own focused chat
Plans can be imported as JSON from any external AI using a versioned schema, so no API key is required to use the app
The import schema doubles as the export format, and later as the data source for the public portfolio page
Import is built before the in-app AI chat because it is simpler and makes the app usable sooner
LLM access goes through a provider interface so Gemini or others can be added later without a rewrite
In-app AI decides when planning is done by calling a create_milestones tool rather than replying in prose
Milestones have acceptance criteria so the Next button stays meaningful
Game features stay minimal (progress bar + confetti) until the core works
open_questions: Whether users can bring their own API key, and how it is stored encrypted
Richer game mechanics beyond the progress bar

milestones.title: Create the repo and a running FastAPI health endpoint
milestones.description: Set up the repository, manage Python with uv, and run a minimal FastAPI app locally without Docker so there is only one new variable at a time.
acceptance_criteria: GET http://localhost:8000/api/health returns {"status": "ok"}
/docs shows the endpoint
First commit pushed to GitHub

milestones.title: Containerize the API and add Postgres with Docker Compose
milestones.description: Write a Dockerfile for the API and a compose file with a Postgres service. Extend the health check to confirm the database connection.
acceptance_criteria: docker compose up starts api and db
GET /api/health reports the database as reachable
Secrets load from a gitignored .env file

milestones.title: Add the React frontend and connect it through the proxy
milestones.description: Scaffold a Vite + React + TypeScript app, proxy /api to FastAPI, and add it to Docker Compose.
acceptance_criteria: The React page displays the API health status
The browser only talks to one origin
All three services start with one command

milestones.title: Define database models and the first migration
milestones.description: Create the User, Project, Milestone, and Message models with Alembic, including parent_project_id and the optional milestone link on messages.
acceptance_criteria: alembic upgrade head creates all four tables
A migration can be rolled back and reapplied cleanly

milestones.title: Implement Google login
milestones.description: Add OAuth login, callback, and logout routes with Authlib, set a session cookie, and create a User on first login.
acceptance_criteria: Logging in with Google shows the user's email in the React app
Logout clears the session
API routes reject unauthenticated requests

milestones.title: Build the plan importer backend
milestones.description: Define the import schema as a Pydantic model, strip code fences and surrounding text, and return clear validation errors.
acceptance_criteria: This file imports successfully
Fenced or prefixed JSON still parses
A missing field returns an error naming the milestone and field

milestones.title: Build the import preview and save flow
milestones.description: Add a React screen to paste or upload a plan, preview and edit it, then save it as a project with milestones.
acceptance_criteria: Nothing is saved until the user confirms
Imported completed milestones are marked done
The new project opens after saving

milestones.title: Build the sidebar and project view
milestones.description: List the user's projects in a sidebar and show the project summary and context, with an editable title.
acceptance_criteria: The sidebar lists only the logged-in user's projects
Renaming a project updates the sidebar
Refreshing the page keeps state

milestones.title: Add milestone pages, the Next button, and the progress bar
milestones.description: Show one milestone per page with its acceptance criteria. Next marks it complete and advances the bar.
acceptance_criteria: The bar reflects completed/total
Progress survives a refresh
The app resumes at the first incomplete milestone

milestones.title: Add the completion screen and completed badge
milestones.description: When the final milestone is done, show a celebration with confetti, mark the project completed, and offer a prompt to generate a resume insert with an external AI.
acceptance_criteria: Confetti plays on completion
A completed icon appears in the sidebar
Completed projects remain viewable but read-only

milestones.title: Add versioning with Continue as 2.0
milestones.description: Create a child project linked to the completed one, defaulting its name to the next version number.
acceptance_criteria: The new project links to its parent
The default name ends in 2.0, 3.0, and so on
The parent project is unchanged

milestones.title: Deploy the app
milestones.description: Deploy the containers with managed Postgres and register the production OAuth redirect URI.
acceptance_criteria: Login works on the public URL
Importing a plan works in production

milestones.title: Add in-app AI chat
milestones.description: Implement the LLM provider interface with one provider and a chat per project and per milestone, injecting the project summary and context into the system prompt.
acceptance_criteria: Messages persist per project and per milestone
The AI's answers reflect the imported context

milestones.title: Add AI milestone generation and resume inserts
milestones.description: Use a create_milestones tool so the AI decides when planning is done, and generate a resume insert on completion.
acceptance_criteria: A new project moves from planning to active when the tool is called
Generated milestones follow the same schema as imports
A resume insert appears on the completion screen
